messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary failures detected for release v1.8.7 in ap-southeast-1; auto-rollback to v1.8.6. See: https://deploys.redwood/4187654321 :bangbang:
Nina R.: Oof. Looking. Any immediate errors in the logs?
Devon H.: Early signs point to a serialization change in the reply formatter that slipped in yesterday's PR. Fails on messages > 4k tokens.
Pri Patel: We should pin to v1.8.6 and ship a hotfix. Ops, can we get a fast-track window?
release-coordinator: Change window ok for next 60m. Need release note stub + owner.
Nina R.: I'll prepare the patch and minimal test. PR coming.
Devon H.: Suggested rollback criteria: error rate >0.3% sustained for 4m OR p95 latency >300ms for 3m. Also if model-serving OOMs appear, auto-rollback.
infra-team: Infra ack. We'll be ready to reroute traffic and revoke the pin if needed. Please include tracing tags `hotfix-187` for quick filter.
Pri Patel: Draft deploy command:```
deploybot expedite --pin v1.8.6 --patch v1.8.7-hotfix-serial --skip-canary --window 60m --owner nina
```
Nina R.: PR: https://git.redwood/patches/2418  Release note draft: "hotfix(serializer): fix serialization regression causing long-sequence failures". Will finalize in 8m. :memo:
deploy-bot: Expedite command accepted from Nina R.. Starting staged rollout with skip-canary. Notifying infra and owners.
infra-team: Rolling at 25% - healthchecks green. Traces: https://metrics.redwood/r/4187654321
Devon H.: Kicked off smoke evals `longseq-reply-smoke` at +5m.
release-coordinator: Reminder: keep feature flag `new-serializer` OFF during this window.
Nina R.: FF already disabled. Smoke evals show one failing prompt at +7m but it's an unrelated flaky test.
infra-team: Seeing a tiny p50 bump (~15ms). Noted. No error spike.
Pri Patel: If p95 crosses 250ms for 5m we vote to rollback.
Nina R.: Agree. Will monitor and call vote if threshold hit.
deploy-bot: Rollout at 68% - healthchecks still passing.
Devon H.: Logs show a downstream store timeout coincident with a compaction job at +12m; error rate briefly hit 0.28% then dropped. Not hitting 4m sustained trigger.
infra-team: Good to hold. We'll throttle compaction if it recurs.
Nina R.: Patch stable at +22m. Finalizing release note and tagging support. Locking pin for 18h to give teams time to backfill tests. Filed follow-up: https://issues.redwood/FT-3109 Owner: Devon H.
Pri Patel: I'll own the RCA and include perf regression tests in the suite. Thanks team for the quick loop. :heart:
release-coordinator: Closing window. Marking release note published. Moving to observation mode. :white_check_mark:
